name: halfkey

subject.name: Halfkey
subject.audience: busy Solana holders who delegate a routine to an agent
subject.primaryJob: let a tired person check what an agent did with their money, against limits they wrote

principles: product systems and modular grids: the dots, type and pages share one grid (D08)
restraint: grey, black, white and one signal color (D07)

territories.name: The receipt
territories.description: A pale dotted ground where every action is itemized: amount, fee, key, signer, in ruled rows.

muse.name: a printed ticket
muse.take: one number first, then ruled lines that account for it (D12)
muse.leave: thermal paper and any skeuomorphic texture

samples.confirmation: Bought 0.2318 SOL for $40.00 on Jupiter. Fee $0.16.
samples.error: An unknown app asked to move all your USDC. No key covers it. Watch stopped it.

signature.concept: one blue, used rarely and loud
signature.reason: D07 gives blue 3% of a typical set of pages so that a small cue is the first thing seen; a selection should land the same way on the receipt's pale ground

avoid: a sparkle icon: the agent is never drawn as magic (D11)

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred, not stated by the deck. Departs from Ulm's crisp corners: D12's cards and pill buttons are round.
rationale.color.anchors.0: D07, printed HEX. Pantone 2728 C on paper.
rationale.color.character.vibrancy: Signal blue is brighter than any print ink (D07)
rationale.type.faces: Stand-in. The deck uses Suisse Int'l only, Medium and Regular, no monospace (D08). Helvetica Neue is the closest system face in the catalogue.
rationale.type.character.type-scale: Display 104 over Body 20 is about 5:1 (D08), which classic matches; dramatic doubled it
rationale.form.curvature: cards are generously round and controls are pills (D12)
rationale.form.line: ruled rows and 1.5 px icons (D08, D11)
rationale.form.elevation: cards separate by tone, no shadows (D12)
rationale.form.space: pale fields with room around one number (D08, D12)
rationale.movement: 240 ms on cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) with no overshoot (D13)
rationale.adaptivity: Ground 56%, Ink 18% across a typical set (D07)
rationale.color.anchors.2: D07, printed HEX; 56% of a typical set.
rationale.color.anchors.3: D07, printed HEX; Black 6 C on paper.
